CustomObject.label: Pricing Procedure
CustomObject.description: Revenue Core - the ordered pricing procedure. Replaces the RCA five-step pricing procedure (UC-CAT-07). Each record is one step; Procedure_Name__c groups the steps into a procedure. Ordering by Step_Number__c keeps the sequence auditable and exportable (docs/revenue-core/03-REVENUE-CORE-SPEC.md 3.1).
